comment:
* Trampoline activity used to start the full screen dialog that is shown when a SIM is inserted
 * and requires a carrier app download

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_RESULT
variables.comment:
* This must remain in sync with
     * {@link com.android.simappdialog.InstallCarrierAppActivity#DOWNLOAD_RESULT}

variables.name: CARRIER_NAME
variables.comment:
* This must remain in sync with
     * {@link com.android.simappdialog.InstallCarrierAppActivity#BUNDLE_KEY_CARRIER_NAME}

variables.name: BUNDLE_KEY_PACKAGE_NAME
variables.comment: Bundle key for the name of the package to be downloaded

methods.name: public static Intent get(Context context, String packageName)
methods.comment: Returns intent used to start this activity

methods.name: protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data)
